states.content: Non-emergency contact with Nadia Lopez must go only through Nadia directly (direct mobile 415-555-0191 first) and the patient portal second, with the portal kept as the backup contact channel and nothing else; emergency channels may be used only in an emergency. The final call list shows Nadia's direct mobile and portal only as contact channels. Family is fully removed from her reminders and contact routing. The weekend check-in script will use Nadia's direct mobile only. Weekend billing notes route only to Nadia and not to family. River House must not reappear anywhere: the old River House backup line (415-555-0168) and the alias Mina have been deleted from shared notes and are excluded from all communications, forms and routing, with no fallback use; Nadia explicitly requests that the old backup route not be resurrected in any reminder. Deleted callback fragments were not restored in the nursing note, consistent with that request. Nadia does not want any work line or old shelter line used for contact; her contact note records that no work line and no deleted shelter line are to be used.
